description: List the connected person's own properties on Fabrica (Ethereum Mainnet), across every wallet on their account: the properties they are adding to Fabrica first, then their live properties by estimated value. Each row has its stage and status, location, acres, listing price, offers waiting, whether it is under a loan, Property checks encoding, estimated value and the property page link; totals cover the count, acres, listings, offers waiting and the estimated value of the live properties. Needs the connection's portfolio:read grant. get_land_portfolio lists any wallet address instead.

includePremints.description: Include properties still being added to Fabrica (default true)

name: get_my_properties
title: Get my properties
